programs.name: minimax_phase_ensemble
programs.description: Use when seasonal structure is clear but rolling errors are unstable, as indicated by the parent SMAPE range of 6.19 to 73.92.
programs.assumption: Among phase estimators using the latest 1, 3, 5, or all cycles, minimizing the maximum SMAPE across three 24-point holdouts produces a maximum holdout SMAPE below 73.92.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if every candidate has maximum rolling SMAPE at least 73.92 or future phase values are unrelated to historical phase values.

programs.name: contextual_cycle_analog
programs.description: Use when the start of the current daily cycle identifies which historical daily trajectory is most relevant and exact zero phases recur.
programs.assumption: For at least two of three rolling 24-point holdouts, a phase-aligned trajectory selected from the 1 to 3 nearest historical contexts has lower SMAPE than the unconditional phase median, and structural-zero phases have an empirical zero rate of at least 0.75.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when fewer than three complete cycles are available, nearest-context distances do not rank future trajectories, or zero phases move between cycles.
